description: estate-ci#261: estate-wide Renovate policy (self-hosted global config, RENOVATE_CONFIG_FILE in scripts/renovate-run.sh). Repository options here are defaults for every covered repository; each repository's renovate.json chooses its managers and may add packageRules.

Renovate proposes PRs only. It never merges, adds digest pins, rewrites first-party or mirrored zot digests (pin-bump.yml and mirrors.txt own those), moves estate-ci reusable-workflow pins or Argo git revisions, and never rebases a PR unless it conflicts.
prBodyNotes: Proposed by the estate version detector (jvallery/estate-ci renovate.yml, STD-OPS-02). It merges like any other pull request in this repository: when the required checks are green. Renovate never merges or syncs.

packageRules.description: First-party images and estate-ci mirrors in the zot origin are pinned by digest through pin-bump.yml and mirrors.txt (STD-IAC pin writer rule), never by Renovate.
No digest-only updates and no new pins: an existing tag@digest or SHA pin moves only together with a version update.
Callers pin estate-ci reusable workflows by full SHA and move them with estate-ci changes (ADR-0006), not through Renovate.
Argo Application git revisions are SHA pins moved by whoever delivers the change. Helm chart versions in Applications stay proposable.
One PR per repository for GitHub Actions updates.
Group non-major pip and npm tool pins into one PR per repository; images, charts and majors stay one PR each.
